name: Orphex
description:
Orphex brings your ad platform data into Claude. Query campaign performance, review Creative AI's ad analysis, and get instant answers on competitor activity and performance anomalies, all without leaving the chat.
Key Features:
 • Campaign performance - Pull spend, conversion, and ROAS data across 35+ connected platforms
 • Creative AI insights - Get Claude's read on what Orphex's Creative AI found in your top ad creatives
 • Competitor tracking - Compare your ad activity against tracked competitors
 • Anomaly alerts - Ask Claude to explain sudden spend or performance changes

_published_faq.name: How do I add Orphex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Orphex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.orphex.co/api/interaction-gateway/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Orphex MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orphex lists 40 MCP tools, including alerts_read, analysis_guide, anomaly_overview, controller_catalog, controller_fetch, creative_ai_section, creative_ai_segment, creative_understanding, export_create, export_status, get_workspaces, and guide_catalog.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Orphex?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Orphex in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Orphex requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Orphex is developed by Orphex. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
